what: hCA II (PDB 6RL9, chain A) with the sulfonamidate anion of sulfanilamide on the zinc, crystal water, TIP3P water and NaCl in a truncated octahedron
status_note: PRODUCTION system (md/PLAN.md, entry of 6 Oct 2026, 9:15 PM IST; md/PRODUCTION.md). Zinc set 2e: MCPB.py step 2e, empirical zinc constants. RESP charges with the equal ligand atoms made equal. Terms at N2 AS BUILT: gates G-R and G-R2 on these terms failed and are reported; they are used by the user's decision of 6 Oct 2026. Whether 2s or 2e is the primary set is decided by gate G-Z and the validation run X0 of each (md/PRODUCTION.md).
units: Angstrom, degrees, e, amu, kcal mol-1 (Amber parameters); nm and kJ mol-1 nm-2 only where the key says so
random_numbers: none; the ion sites follow a fixed rule (ions.rule) and tleap places nothing by chance

pairs_across_the_zinc.rule: Amber: atoms one or two bonds apart do not interact (excluded); atoms three bonds apart interact with the electrostatics divided by 1.2 and the Lennard-Jones term by 2.0 (1-4); atoms four or more bonds apart interact in full. Checked here for every pair whose bonds run through the zinc
pairs_across_the_zinc.zinc_to_sulfonyl_oxygens: three bonds apart (Zn-N2-S-O): a 1-4 pair, scaled as above

against_the_restrained_system_of_this_st.note: each pair is [this system, the restrained system]

box.shape: truncated octahedron (tleap solvateOct; triclinic cell with three equal edges)
tleap_solvation_lines: Scaling up box by a factor of 1.188575 to meet diagonal cut criterion
Total bounding box for atom centers:  96.151 96.151 96.151
box.note: as built the box is larger than it will be at 1 bar (see density_as_built); 'any orientation' is the cell edge minus the largest extent of the solute, a lower bound for a rigid solute

ions.rule: pairs = round(c * N_water / c_water) with c = 0.15 mol/L, c_water = 55.3 mol/L (water at 300 K) and N_water the water molecules after solvateOct (crystal water included): the concentration in the volume of the solvent. Then one Na+ per negative charge of the solute.

placement.rule: each ion replaces one water molecule added by solvateOct, never a crystal water: candidates are the added molecules whose O is at least 6.0 A from every atom of protein, zinc, ligand and crystal water; they are ordered by sha256('cqc-sfa-md ion sites|<seed>|<k>') (k = place among the added molecules, from 0) and taken in that order if at least 6.0 A (minimum image) from every site already taken; the kinds alternate Na+, Cl- in the order taken
placement.why_not_tleap: addIonsRand has no seed (its help text: the result differs between invocations) and may replace a crystal water; addIons puts every ion on the protein surface
